nodes.label: night-build Branch
nodes.description: Git branch containing 17 commits of feature development with all cargo tests passing (42 tests green), safe to review and merge.

nodes.label: World Gammes (28+)
nodes.description: 28+ scales including Western modes, world traditions (maqam, raga, gamelan), blues, harmonic/melodic minor, whole-tone, chromatic, and microtonals.

nodes.label: Maqam (Arabic Music)
nodes.description: Arabic music scales with quarter-tones. Approximated in 12-TET; full microtonal layer planned.

nodes.label: Raga (Indian Music)
nodes.description: Indian classical scale system. Supported as a gamme option.

nodes.label: Gamelan (Indonesian Music)
nodes.description: Indonesian ensemble music scales (slendro, pelog). Supported as gamme options.

nodes.label: Chords (Accords)
nodes.description: 30+ chord qualities (maj, m, dim, aug, 7, maj7, m7, sus, add9, etc.). MAJUSCULE token = chord, minuscule = single note.

nodes.label: Roman Numeral Chords
nodes.description: Diatonic chords using I ii iii IV V vi vii (+7 for seventh). Qualities adapt to the scale.

nodes.label: Arpeggios
nodes.description: Spreads chord notes over the beat duration using | arp up/down/updown/downup/converge/diverge/thumb/pinky.

nodes.label: Euclidean Rhythms
nodes.description: Distributes k hits evenly over n steps using Bjorklund algorithm. Notation: e(k,n) or e(k,n,rot).

nodes.label: Probabilistic Notes
nodes.description: Tokens play conditionally: x? (~50%), x?70 (70%), c3?25. Applies to any token type.

nodes.label: Seed (Reproducible Randomness)
nodes.description: seed: N makes random choices reproducible. RNG: SplitMix64/(seed,bar,voice,step). Change seed for variation.

nodes.label: Ratchets & Rolls
nodes.description: x*N fires N rapid hits in one step. Combinable with probability: x*4?60. Fills and buildups.

nodes.label: Sidechain / Ducking (Pump)
nodes.description: Global ducking directive: duck: N. Master gains pump at each kick hit. Techno/house pump effect.

nodes.label: Song Structure
nodes.description: Arrangement syntax: song: intro*4 verse*8 chorus*8… (name*bars, loops). Enables long-form pieces.

nodes.label: Section Tagging
nodes.description: Voices tagged with | in verse chorus only play in those sections. Drives/drops by adding/removing layers.

nodes.label: WAV Export (Audio Recording)
nodes.description: REC button: captures stereo 16-bit WAV output. RENDER: bounces entire piece to WAV.

nodes.label: MIDI Out
nodes.description: | midi CH sends voice to DAW/synth hardware. Drums → GM channel 10. Playable in any DAW.

nodes.label: URL Sharing
nodes.description: Share button: copies link (code encoded in URL). Play and edit shared pieces instantly.

nodes.label: Video Export (FILM)
nodes.description: Exports video (format: vertical/square/wide). Title card, music synced to visuals.

nodes.label: Visual Scenes (95+)
nodes.description: 95 built-in visualizers: radial, tunnel, starfield, kaleido, aurora, julia, plasma, mandelbrot, lorenz, etc. Canvas2D + 4 GPU shaders.

nodes.label: Terminal Themes
nodes.description: 6 visual themes: CRT (green), AMBER, C64, DOS, APPLE II, MODERN. Selectable row, localStorage saved.
